title: IronHost – a voxel battlefield sim with tactical destruction, built with Claude Code + Codex + MonoGame (free demo)
author: komorra
selftext:
Hi! I’m developing IronHost, a third-person voxel battlefield game where infantry, mechs, tanks and aircraft fight in a world that’s almost entirely destructible. Destruction is tactical: bridges and buildings collapse when their supports go, and the rubble blocks paths.

How AI is used:

* Claude Code (Opus 5.5) does the main orchestration: game code (C#/MonoGame), networking, and a set of custom CLI tools that the agent runs itself.
* Custom tools written with the agent: a voxel asset generator, procedural vegetation and city generators, a map generator, and a GPU explosion/smoke baker.
* Codex (image gen) makes the 2D assets: menu art, UI, HUD, icons.
* ElevenLabs for sound effects.

The free demo is on itch.io: [IronHost by komorra](https://komorra.itch.io/ironhost)

I’m happy to answer questions about the agent workflow or the voxel rendering. If you’d like to follow development: [https://discord.gg/bvxF5fNBR4](https://discord.gg/bvxF5fNBR4) and r/IronHost.
